searchStrategy.title: Search Strategy
searchStrategy.automaticDescription: REA automatically selects the search strategy based on the number of eligible candidate attributes. Exact Level-Wise Search is used up to the configured candidate limit; larger candidate sets use Beam Search.
searchStrategy.exactDescription: Exact Level-Wise Search systematically explores eligible attribute combinations up to the configured maximum combination size. It provides more complete exploration but can become computationally expensive for large candidate sets.
searchStrategy.beamDescription: Beam Search uses a heuristic search that retains only the highest-ranked candidate combinations at each depth. It is more scalable for large candidate sets but does not evaluate every possible combination.
searchStrategy.exactSearchMaxCandidateCountHelper: Maximum number of eligible candidate attributes for Exact Level-Wise Search in Automatic mode.
searchStrategy.maxCombinationSizeHelper: Maximum number of attributes allowed in a searched QID combination.

beamSearch.title: Beam Search
beamSearch.automaticDescription: These settings are used when Automatic search selection chooses Beam Search for a larger candidate set.
beamSearch.beamDescription: Beam Search keeps only the highest-ranked candidate combinations at each search depth. A larger beam explores more alternatives but requires more computation.
beamSearch.beamWidthHelper: Maximum number of ranked candidate combinations retained for expansion at each search depth.
beamSearch.minImprovementHelper: Minimum increase in the best search signal considered meaningful between successive depths.
beamSearch.stagnationDepthLimitHelper: Number of consecutive search depths without sufficient improvement before Beam Search stops.

searchTargets.title: Search Targets
searchTargets.description: Search targets determine when an already strong candidate no longer needs to be expanded into larger combinations. Both targets must be reached. These are search-control values, not Distinguishability assessment thresholds.
searchTargets.targetDistinctionHelper: Minimum Distinction target used when deciding whether a candidate should be expanded further.
searchTargets.targetSeparationHelper: Minimum Separation target used together with Target Distinction when deciding whether a candidate should be expanded further.

candidateRanking.title: Candidate Ranking
candidateRanking.automaticDescription: Ranking orders candidate combinations and, when Beam Search is selected, determines which candidates remain available for further expansion.
candidateRanking.exactDescription: Ranking orders discovered combinations and influences which results are retained. It does not determine which combinations Exact Search evaluates.
candidateRanking.beamDescription: Ranking determines which candidate combinations remain in the beam and therefore directly influences which search branches are explored.
candidateRanking.distinctionWeightHelper: Relative contribution of Distinction to the candidate ranking score.
candidateRanking.separationWeightHelper: Relative contribution of Separation to the candidate ranking score.
candidateRanking.attributeCountPenaltyHelper: Penalty applied to larger combinations so smaller combinations are preferred when otherwise similarly ranked.

resultRetention.title: Result Retention
resultRetention.description: Controls how many of the discovered aggregate QID combinations are kept after the search completes.
resultRetention.maxPersistedCombinationsHelper: Maximum number of aggregate QID combination results retained after discovery. This does not limit how many combinations may be evaluated during the search.
